title: 巴黎市郊男子开车扫射1死4伤 女童身中8枪
summary: #JUSTIN: One person was killed, and four others were injured in a drive-by shooting in the western suburbs of Paris A 12
body: #JUSTIN: One person was killed, and four others were injured in a drive-by shooting in the western suburbs of Paris A 12-year-old girl is among the injured. A gunman using an automatic or “military-grade” weapon opened fire from a vehicle, appearing to shoot relatively at random. Trappes Mayor Ali Rabeh said the shooter seemed intent on “carrying out a massacre.” According to a CNN source close to the case, the shooter is a 39-year-old male from a nearby town. French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu confirmed a male suspect was quickly tracked down, arrested in Coignières, and taken into custody.#JanonesELulaAoVivoAgora #LISA_Tarantino #bist100 #الرياض #LYKN #SanchezEnLaRevuelta — Tanyak Raphael(,) (@tanyak46626) October 23, 2026 在法国爆发全国骚乱之际，巴黎郊外10月23日发生一宗枪击案，一名男子开车沿街对人群随机开枪，造成至少一人死亡、四人受伤，伤者中包括一名12岁女孩。目前，疑犯已被警方拘捕。法国内政部长努涅斯（Laurent Nuñez）指，事件显然是恐怖主义罪行。
